text:
Ari (Designer): Heads-up — support reported confusion on the model upload error banner. Current banner says: "Upload failed. Try again." with a single "Retry" button. Users can't tell if retry resumes or restarts. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal.mock/snap/upload-banner.png

Devon (ENG): Backend returns error.type {network, quota, file_too_large, checksum}. We currently ignore it. We can show tailored copy and CTAs. For resumable uploads we return resume_token=true.

Priya (CS): From tickets: people retry repeatedly then hit quota. We should suggest next steps (reduce file size, contact admin) and avoid alarmist language.

Samira (A11y): Agree on explicit verbs. Screen reader note: use role="alert" for immediate errors, aria-describedby linking to action text, and include sr-only error codes. Avoid vague phrasing like "failed" without context.

Ari (Designer): Draft microcopy variants:
- Resumable/network: "Upload interrupted. Resume upload to continue where it left off." CTAs: [Resume upload] [Cancel]
- Non-resumable/network: "Upload interrupted. Retry to start again." CTAs: [Retry upload] [Cancel]
- File too large: "This file exceeds the {{limit}} limit. Reduce the file size or split the model." CTAs: [Learn how] [Cancel]
- Quota: "Storage quota reached for your org. Contact your admin or manage billing." CTAs: [Contact support] [Manage billing]

Devon (ENG): Implementation plan: map error.type to banner variant, only show primary-first in DOM, set aria-live for status changes. For resume flow primary should be Resume (actionable). We'll add prefilled support link for Contact support.

Priya (CS): Prefill should include workspace id and error code. For KB links route to /docs/model-upload#splitting-models. For Manage billing route to org billing page.

Samira (A11y): A few specific nits: 1) When resuming, set button to aria-disabled while handshake occurs and announce via aria-live polite: "Resuming upload..." 2) Add sr-only: "Error code: ERR_UPLOAD_42" 3) Make banners keyboard dismissible with Escape (except for quota which should require explicit action to clear).

Ari (Designer): Tone: calm, helpful, no exclamation points. I'll add the microcopy to the component story and include the sr-only examples.

Devon (ENG): I'll push a small banner component PR with the variants and aria attributes. PR: https://git.redwood/pr/4689. Tagging @Ari @Samira for review.

build-bot: preview deployed: https://preview.redwood-internal/mock/upload-errors/v1 (expires in 48h) :package:

Ari (Designer): Thanks — will review the PR and check visual spacing for two-line banners. Priya please confirm KB links.

Priya (CS): Confirmed KB links and prefill params. Minor suggestion: for Learn how, include a 1-2 step quick tip inline (e.g., "Use git-lfs or split into shards").

Samira (A11y): I'll give a quick pass once PR updated. Focus order and live region behavior are the main checks.

Devon (ENG): Updated PR with Samira's notes. Ready for final review.

Ari (Designer): Merging after approvals. Leaving a design note: keep CTAs to two maximum and prefer primary-first DOM for accessibility. :slightly_smiling_face:
